categories.name: Brakes
categories.blurb: Big brake kits, pads and lines

products.name: Sidex Street coilover kit
products.description: Monotube coilovers built for daily driving with weekend track use. Height-adjustable via the lower bracket so you keep full damper travel at any ride height. Includes pillowball top mounts on the front and a rear helper spring so the wheel stays loaded over bumps.

products.name: Sidex Drift Spec coilover kit
products.short: 10k/8k springs, extended-travel rears, inverted front dampers
products.description: Set up for drifting from the box: stiff front end for turn-in, softer rear for grip on exit. Inverted front dampers take the side loads from steering lock so the seals last.

products.name: Sidex Street coilover kit
products.short: Road-biased setup, 7k/5k springs, separate height and preload
products.description: Comfortable enough to commute on, firm enough that the car stops rolling through roundabouts. Separate height and preload adjustment means lowering the car doesn't stiffen the spring.

products.name: Kimura cat-back exhaust
products.short: 76 mm T304 stainless, twin 100 mm tips, no drone at motorway speed
products.description: Full stainless system from the catalytic converter back. Resonated centre section keeps the cabin quiet at 70 mph while the rear silencer is straight-through for a clean note on throttle.

products.name: Kimura tubular exhaust manifold
products.short: Equal-length 4-1 for SR20DET, T25/T28 flange, 42 mm runners
products.description: Equal-length runners so all four cylinders reach the turbine at the same time, which is what you feel as quicker spool. Thick 10 mm flanges to resist warping under heat cycles.

products.name: Sidex decat pipe
products.short: Direct replacement for the OE cat, 63 mm bore, lambda boss included
products.description: Straight pipe replacing the catalytic converter. For off-road and track use only: it will not pass a UK MOT emissions test.

products.name: Halt 6-piston big brake kit
products.short: 356 mm two-piece discs, forged monoblock calipers, braided lines
products.description: Front kit for cars that see track days. Two-piece floating discs shed heat faster than solid discs and weigh less. Calipers are machined from a single billet so they don't flex under a hard stop.

products.name: Halt Track pad set (front)
products.short: Semi-metallic compound, works from cold, 650 C fade limit
products.description: A pad that bites from the first corner and keeps biting after twenty laps. Dustier than road pads, so expect to clean your wheels.

products.name: Halt braided brake line kit
products.short: Stainless braided, PVC coated, four lines with fittings
products.description: Replaces the rubber flexi hoses that swell under pressure. Firmer pedal and more consistent feel, especially once the fluid is hot.

specs.Construction: PTFE core, stainless braid, PVC coat

products.name: Sidex FF-6 wheel 18x9.5
products.short: Flow-formed, 5x114.3, ET22, 9.1 kg, price per wheel
products.description: Flow-formed barrel gives close to forged strength at a cast price. Concave six-spoke face with a deep lip on the 9.5-inch width.

products.name: Sidex FF-6 wheel 17x9
products.short: Flow-formed, 5x120 or 5x114.3, ET25, 8.4 kg, price per wheel
products.description: The 17-inch version of the FF-6 for cars that want tyre sidewall. Same flow-formed construction and same face.

products.name: Vortan cold air intake
products.short: Mandrel-bent aluminium, heat shield, dry cone filter
products.description: Moves the filter out of the engine bay heat and gives the engine a smoother path to the throttle body. Dry filter means no oiling and no risk of fouling the MAF sensor.

products.name: Vortan front-mount intercooler
products.short: 600x300x76 mm bar-and-plate core, full pipe kit, silicone couplers
products.description: Drops intake temperatures by around 25 C on a stock turbo. Bar-and-plate core is heavier than tube-and-fin but far tougher against stone strikes.

products.name: Gripline Stage 2 clutch kit
products.short: Organic sprung disc, 30% stronger pressure plate, rated to 400 Nm
products.description: Holds more torque than stock without a heavy pedal. Organic friction material means it drives like a normal car in traffic.

products.name: Gripline 2-way LSD
products.short: Clutch-type, 2-way, drop-in for 188 mm medium case
products.description: Locks under both acceleration and braking, which is what you want for drifting: both rear wheels spin together and the car stays predictable on entry. Not ideal for a daily driver.

products.name: Sidex front bumper
products.short: Polyurethane, unpainted, larger intake for front-mount intercooler
products.description: Flexible polyurethane so it survives a kerb tap without cracking. The centre opening is sized for a 600 mm intercooler core.

products.name: Sidex GT wing
products.short: 1500 mm carbon fibre blade, adjustable angle, chassis-mount uprights
products.description: Mounts through the boot floor to the chassis so the downforce goes into the car, not the boot lid. Angle adjustable in 3 degree steps.
